instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["height"] - 0.013) < 0.005 and abs(c["yaw"] - (-0.735 + 1.5708)) < 0.1:
        best_candidate = c
        break
grasp(best_candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
target = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(target["x"], target["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
